Kantorjanosi Jewish Cemetery One

Jewish Cemetery · Kántorjánosi, Hungary

Not demolished. One of two Jewish cemeteries that once existed in Kántorjánosi, this site's earliest tombstone dates to 1841, and its main period of use ran until around 1944, when the village's Jewish community - 159 people out of 3,318 residents by 1941 - was deported. One outlying gravestone dates as late as 1984. The Jewish population had earlier grown substantially, from 31 residents in 1840 to a peak of 274 in 1880, before gradually declining to 224 by 1910 and 245 by 1920. The cemetery remains fenced today.
